summary.text: Candy Massaroni is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 50 since 2023 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Candy Massaroni lives in Bardstown, Kentucky.
She took office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Chad McCoy (R).
In the 2025-2026 session Massaroni was assigned to the House Agriculture Committee, the Postsecondary Education Committee, and the House Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.
